claims.subject: Death Plateau

value.listed_requirements: none (the Quest details box has no requirements field)
items: 60 coins (bring 1,000 for the dice with Harold)

claims.statement: Death Plateau has no skill or quest requirements: its Quest details box lists no requirements field. It needs 60+ coins (1,000 recommended), 10 bread, 10 cooked trout, an iron bar and an Asgarnian ale.

sources.title: Death Plateau
sources.quote: |items = * 60 [[coins]] (bring 1000 for the gambling dice with Harold part) *10 unnoted [[bread]] *10 unnoted cooked [[trout]] *[[Iron bar]] *[[Asgarnian ale]] (can be found on the bar at the pub in [[Burthorpe]])

claims.notes: The iron bar can be bought (standard HW account) or smelted (Mining 15 + Smithing 15; owner 42/31). The ironman list also names an iron bar spawn in level 18 Wilderness: do not route that option on Hardcore Worlds. Same revision as F-2026, which already settled 'no listed requirements'.

claims.subject: Death Plateau

value.hazard: trolls on the normal (northern) path attack; the secret path is not attacked

claims.statement: Death Plateau has no required fights. Trolls attack only on the normal northern path, which a warning sign marks; the walkthrough routes the player along Tenzing's secret path, where the trolls do not attack.

sources.title: Death Plateau
sources.quote: A wounded soldier marks the dangerous route towards the north. '''{{Colour|red|Warning}}:''' ''If you head north, a warning sign will tell you that Death Plateau is dangerous and you will be attacked by trolls. Do not go this way! Head back south-west.''

sources.title: Death Plateau
sources.quote: You may get a popup message saying that you'll be assailed by trolls if you continue while walking along the secret path. Ignore it, as the trolls will only attack if you're on the normal path.

claims.notes: The levels and max hits of the trolls on the northern path were not on the quest page (gap). The Threat desk should rate the wrong-path risk.

claims.subject: Shield of Arrav

value.partner_already_done: may help only if they chose to obtain extra certificate halves before completing
value.trade_free_method: use the key and certificate halves on the partner

claims.statement: Shield of Arrav cannot be fully completed alone: it needs a partner who picks the opposing gang. The key and certificate halves can be used on the partner instead of traded. The wiki points to the official chat-channel 'OSRS SOA' to find one.

sources.title: Shield of Arrav
sources.quote: During this quest, you must choose one of two gangs to join. In order to fully complete it, you '''must have a partner''', and they must pick the '''opposing''' gang.

sources.title: Shield of Arrav
sources.quote: It is possible to avoid the trade interface by '''using''' the key and certificate halves obtained during the quest on your partner, allowing the quest to be completed by [[ironmen]] and players with new account [[Account#New account trade restrictions|trade restrictions]].

claims.notes: The page warns of scams because items change hands with a stranger.

claims.subject: Hardcore Worlds

value.implication: a Shield of Arrav / Heroes' Quest partner must be another Hardcore Worlds character (inference)

claims.statement: Hardcore Worlds run on separate servers but its characters are main accounts that can trade with other players and do group PvM. So a quest partner has to be another Hardcore Worlds player on a Hardcore world.

sources.title: Hardcore Worlds
sources.quote: They run on a separate set of [[server]]s than the standard worlds. ... Players on Hardcore Worlds are still [[main account]]s, therefore they can still [[trade]] with other players, use the [[Grand Exchange]], or participate in group [[Monster killing|PvM]], unlike in other modes such as [[Ironman Mode|ironman]].

claims.notes: That a main-game character cannot partner a Hardcore Worlds character is inferred from 'separate set of servers'; no source says so outright. Whether the 'OSRS SOA' chat-channel or the Grouping interface reaches Hardcore Worlds players is unknown (gap).
